description: Ask a platform admin to approve a sensitive capability for an app: a managed database, sign-in bypass paths, headless mode, public visibility, a raw TCP/UDP host port, a custom domain without AppCrane sign-in, outbound e-mail, an external secret store connection, the LLM gateway, outbound internet hosts (egress) or a platform API connection (connection:<name>). Owner or app admin of the app. Give a reason and the narrowest scope that works; the admin may narrow it further and set an expiry. One open request per app and capability: asking again returns the open one. This only files the request: a platform admin decides it in the dashboard, and an agent can never approve one. Scope by capability (examples): managed_database {"engines":["postgres"]}; auth_bypass_paths {"paths":["/webhooks"]}; headless {}; public_visibility {}; tcp_ports {"ingress_type":"tcp","public_port":null}; outbound_email {"recipient_domains":["example.test"]}; external_secret_connections {"providers":["vault"]}; custom_domain_unprotected {"domains":["app.example.test"]}; llm_gateway {}; egress {"hosts":["api.example.test"]}.

capability.description: One of managed_database, auth_bypass_paths, headless, public_visibility, tcp_ports, outbound_email, external_secret_connections, custom_domain_unprotected, llm_gateway, egress, or connection:<name> for a platform connection (scope { methods, path_prefixes }).

reason.description: Why the app needs it (required, up to 1000 characters).

scope.description: What exactly is needed, in the shape shown for the capability.

name: appcrane_request_capability
